view: Close view through weathered coral rag stone arched doorway at Gedi into roofless domestic courtyard, roots and coastal forest beyond, pale rough masonry plaster traces recessed wall niches, no inland savannah or grand Arab palace.

eras.title: A doorway in the coastal forest
eras.caption: Gedi's coral-stone houses, mosques and water systems survive within coastal forest. Excavated pottery and the town's buildings reveal a Swahili community connected with trade across the Indian Ocean.
